title: SP3 Protocol for Protein Extraction from Archaeological Cooking Vessels
author: Virginia L Harvey
materials: Preheat a Thermomixer or equivalent heating and shaking device to 24°C or room temperature.
Carefully invert the bottles of bead stock solutions and knock (!) them firmly on the counter to gain an equal distribution of the beads in the stock solution.

steps.title: Prepare TCEP and CAA solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 100 mM TCEP and 100 mM CAA solution.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 28.66 mg TCEP and 9.35 mg CAA into a darkened tube or one wrapped with foil.
Add 1 mL ultrapure water and vortex for 1 minute to homogenise.

Combine 500 µL of Sera-Mag Speedbead carboxylate-modified [E3] magnetic particles (Cytiva Life Sciences Catalog #65152105050250) with 500 µL of Sera-Mag™ SpeedBead Carboxylate-Modified [E7] Magnetic Particles (Cytiva Life Sciences Catalog #45152105050250) in a tube.
Place on a magnetic rack and remove the supernatant.
Wash the beads 3 times by removing them from the rack, resuspending in 1000 µL ultrapure water, homogenising via pipetting, placing back on the rack, and removing the supernatant.
After the final wash, resuspend the beads in 1000 µL ultrapure water and homogenise through gentle pipetting.

steps.title: Prepare foodcrust samples
steps.instruction: Sample foodcrust into new Protein Low-Bind tubes.

substeps.instruction: Use a suggested mass of 10-20 mg per sample, depending on availability.

steps.title: Extract proteins from foodcrust
steps.instruction: Solubilise proteins using GuHCl and heat.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL 6 M GuHCl to each sample.
Briefly vortex to homogenise and centrifuge for 1 minute at 13k RPM.
Incubate samples at 65°C for 1 hour on a heat block, then remove from heat.
Centrifuge the samples at 13k RPM for 1 minute to pellet the foodcrust.
Transfer the supernatant (containing solubilised proteins) to a new tube and discard the pellets.

steps.title: Reduce and alkylate proteins
steps.instruction: Treat proteins with TCEP and CAA.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL of the prepared 100 mM TCEP and 100 mM CAA solution.
Briefly vortex to homogenise and centrifuge for 1 minute at 13k RPM.
Incubate samples at 99°C for 10 minutes in a heat block.
Remove from heat and allow to cool at room temperature for approximately 5 minutes.

steps.title: Bind proteins to magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Capture proteins using magnetic beads and ethanol precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µg of beads (10 µL of a 50 µg/µL bead solution in ultrapure water) to each sample (maintaining a 1:10 protein to bead concentration ratio).
Homogenise through gentle aspirating and dispensing with a pipette.
Add 175 µL 100% ethanol (volume should equal the current sample volume) and homogenise through pipetting.
Incubate in a Thermomixer at 24°C and 1000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Place samples on a magnetic separation rack for at least 2 minutes.
Remove and discard (or save for efficiency testing) the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Perform sequential ethanol washes to clean the beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: Remove from rack, add 500 µL 80% ethanol, resuspend by gentle pipetting, place on rack for 2 minutes, and discard supernatant.
Wash 2: Remove from rack, add 300 µL 80% ethanol, resuspend by gentle pipetting, place on rack for 2 minutes, and discard supernatant.
Wash 3: Remove from rack, add 200 µL 80% ethanol, resuspend by gentle pipetting, place on rack for 2 minutes, and discard as much supernatant as possible.

steps.title: Elute proteins from beads
steps.instruction: Release proteins from the beads into elution buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 100 µL 50 mM ABC and homogenise through gentle pipetting.
Place samples on a thermomixer at 37°C and 750 RPM for 3 minutes.
Place on the magnetic rack for at least 2 minutes.
Remove 10 µL of the eluate and store separately for protein quantification (e.g., Bradford or BCA assay).

steps.title: Digest proteins with trypsin
steps.instruction: Perform tryptic digestion of the eluted proteins.

substeps.instruction: Prepare trypsin solution: Resuspend 20 µg of Sequencing grade Trypsin (Promega Catalog #V5111) with 100 µL resuspension buffer to create a 0.2 µg/µL solution.
Add 1 µL of this trypsin solution to each sample.
Incubate at 37°C and 750 RPM for 18 hours.
Remove from mixer and centrifuge at 13k RPM for 1 minute.
Place on the magnetic rack for at least 2 minutes.
Transfer all supernatant to new Protein Low-Bind tubes and discard the beads.
Halt tryptic activity by adding 10 µL 5% v/v TFA.
Prime C18 ZipTips by aspirating and discarding 100 µL 50% ACN + 0.1% TFA twice.
Wash the ZipTip by aspirating and discarding 100 µL 0.1% TFA twice.
Desalt samples by aspirating and dispensing 5-10 times in the sample to bind peptides to the C18 filter.
Wash the ZipTip by aspirating and discarding 100 µL 0.1% TFA twice.
Elute peptides into a new Low-Bind tube by aspirating and dispensing 100 µL 50% ACN + 0.1% TFA.
